summary: Detects clicks on TMP rich-text <link> tags and reports the link id.
overview: Drop it on a TMP_Text containing link tags and it fires OnLinkClicked with the link's id string. Works for UI and 3D world-space text — world-space needs the rendering camera passed, since there is no parent Canvas to infer it from.
useCases: Clickable terms, credits or help references inside body text.
An inline keyword that opens a glossary entry.
Choice text embedded in a dialogue line rather than on buttons.

gotchas.title: World-space text needs a camera
gotchas.body: With no parent Canvas there is nothing to infer the camera from, so hit-testing fails silently until one is supplied.

gotchas.title: It reports the id, not the visible text
gotchas.body: The id in the tag is what you get. Keeping ids stable while the display text is localised is the point of the split.
